Domino Data Lab and EPAM Partner to Accelerate AI Adoption in Life Sciences
summary:
Domino Data Lab, provider of the unified platform to build, scale, and govern enterprise AI solutions for the most consequential industries, today announced a strategic partnership with EPAM, a leading global AI and digital transformation services, product engineering, and integrated strategy, experience, and technology consulting company. The collaboration pairs EPAM’s custom systems engineering expertise with Domino’s platform, helping joint customers deploy GxP-validated AI models and governed enterprise analytics across R&D.
While life sciences organisations are eager to scale advanced AI, moving models and applications out of experimental sandboxes into validated production remains a primary bottleneck. Domino’s latest industry research identifies legacy system fragmentation, GxP revalidation demands, and governance hurdles as the primary barriers before AI initiatives can deliver impact. Domino provides the platform layer to bridge these gaps, while EPAM delivers the specialised domain engineering to integrate it into enterprise IT stacks.
“Our strategic partnership with Domino marks a significant step toward AI-native transformation throughout the pharmaceutical industry, backed by EPAM's forward-deployed engineering (FDE) capabilities and industry experience across the life sciences value chain,” said Nir Kaldero, Chief Data and AI Strategist at EPAM. “With Domino, we aim to generate meaningful value worldwide using our AI/RUN™ Transformation frameworks in a complex, dynamic business and technology environment.”
“Pharma’s AI opportunity doesn’t live in one function, and every team it touches has its own systems, timelines, and compliance requirements,” said Greg Killian, Senior Vice President and Global Head of Life Sciences and Healthcare at EPAM. “EPAM and Domino are built for that complexity, helping organisations move AI into validated production no matter which team is building it.”
EPAM’s dedicated integration teams and FDEs work alongside Domino’s FDEs. Together, they embed directly with customer teams to accelerate deployment timelines, modernise legacy code, and ensure strict compliance across heterogeneous IT architectures.
“Life sciences leaders don’t want AI that only works for one pilot,” said Ricky Mann, Chief Solutions Officer at Domino. “Pairing EPAM’s implementation experience with Domino’s platform lets leaders scale AI solutions enterprise-wide, not just within a single function.”
Delivering solutions across the biopharma lifecycle 
Together, EPAM and Domino help leaders:
Advance discovery and target identification: Improve candidate selection by running AI agents, LLMs, and machine learning pipelines against large-scale genomic datasets.
Modernise statistical computing: Shorten regulatory submission timelines by giving biostatisticians and statistical programmers a governed environment to unify SAS, R, and Python, from analysis through TFL generation.
Scale real-world evidence: Speed observational research by standardising massive, heterogeneous real-world data sets on a secure analytics layer.

More Financial Data Doesn't Necessarily Mean Better Financial Decisions
content: Having access to a greater volume of financial data does not automatically lead to better decision-making. According to a community discussion on Finextra, simply accumulating more information can sometimes overwhelm decision-makers rather than clarify financial strategies. Quality and actionable insights remain far more critical for effective outcomes than sheer data volume in modern finance.
content_ta: அதிகப்படியான நிதி தரவுகளுக்கான அணுகுமுறை எப்போதுமே சிறந்த முடிவெடுப்பதற்கான வழிவகுப்பதில்லை என்று ஒரு Finextra சமூக விவாதம் தெரிவிக்கின்றது. அதிகமான தகவல்களைச் சேகரிப்பது நிதி மூலோபாயங்களைத் தெளிவுபடுத்துவதற்குப் பதிலாக முடிவெடுப்பவர்களைக் குழப்பக்கூடும். நவீன நிதியியலில் தரவு அளவை விட தரமான நுண்ணறிவுகளே சிறந்த முடிவுகளுக்கு மிகவும் அவசியமானவையாக இருக்கின்றன.

Experian Expands Its Range of Services in Snowflake to Help Businesses Unlock the True Value from Their Customer Data
summary:
Experian, the global data and technology company, today announces the expansion of its capabilities within Snowflake, the AI Data Cloud company, with the launch of two new Snowflake Native Apps. The services will empower organisations to improve the quality of their customer contact information and create audience segments for paid media campaigns using their own existing customer data.
Customers can natively access these capabilities within Snowflake's AI Data Cloud, helping to keep data secure and within the organisation’s control, as well as strengthen privacy and compliance protections. This includes:
Contact Data Validation: Organisations can efficiently validate, standardise and enrich physical addresses, email addresses and phone numbers directly within the Snowflake AI Data Cloud, helping improve campaign reach and customer engagement, reduce failed deliveries and communications, and strengthen the quality of data used for analytics and AI.
Audience Activate: Businesses can connect their own customer data to a range of digital identifiers required for marketing channels. With 85% digital connectivity to UK households, Audience Activate helps organisations reach more of their customers across more touchpoints, improving the relevancy, efficiency and performance of paid media campaigns.
By removing the need to transfer customer data outside their Snowflake environments, Audience Activate helps organisations reduce complexity, accelerates audience activation, while ensuring data remains protected, governed and fully under their control.
Andrew Abraham, Global Managing Director, Experian Data Quality, said: “In today's data-driven world, businesses need confidence that the data powering their customer engagement, analytics and AI strategies is accurate, actionable and trusted.
“Experian is constantly innovating to help businesses overcome data challenges and unlock new opportunities. We're excited to deepen our relationship with Snowflake and help organisations improve the quality of their data where it already lives, reach the right audiences, and turn trusted data into better customer and business outcomes."
Colin Grieves, Managing Director, Experian Marketing Services UK&I, said: "Businesses want to unlock more value from their existing customer data, but when it comes to activating across paid media, there’s often a gap between the customer data they own, and their ability to turn it into actionable audiences across digital marketing channels. With Audience Activate, we're helping businesses bridge the gap in a simpler, faster and privacy-conscious way.
"Brands can connect their customer data to channel-relevant identifiers and build and deploy audiences to advertising platforms without moving customer data outside their Snowflake environment, giving them the ability to scale digital reach, improve marketing efficiency and deliver growth, all whilst maintaining strong data governance and control."
The integrations are the latest between Experian and Snowflake. Earlier this year, Experian announced Aperture Data Studio’s integration with Snowflake, giving organisations the ability to profile, transform and validate data directly within the Snowflake platform.
Experian is a sponsor of the Snowflake World Tour, taking place at ExCeL London today (September 30th). In the panel session, How to Turn Customer Data into Actionable Intelligence, Experian will discuss how businesses can unlock greater value from their data, build trust in their insights and engage customers more effectively.
A free trial of the Contact Data Validation app is available today; interested organisations are encouraged to request access. The app will be available globally via the Snowflake Marketplace later this year. Audience Activate is currently in Beta testing with a select group of customers, and will be available to UK businesses from January 2027.

Madisyn Pettaway, 31, entered the guilty plea in a federal court located in Bridgeport. According to the U.S. Attorney's Office for the District of Connecticut, the defendant attempted to deposit the stolen funds into an account, leading to the federal prosecution and criminal charges.
content_ta: ஸ்டென் செய்யப்பட் $410,000-க்கும் அதிகமான மதிப்புள்ள U.S. Treasury செக் மோசடி வழக்கில் New Jersey-யைச் சேர்ந்த பெண் ஒருவர் வங்கி மோசடி குற்றத்தை ஒப்புக்கொண்டார். 31 வயதான Madisyn Pettaway, Bridgeport-ல் உள்ள ஃபெடரல் நீதிமன்றத்தில் குற்றத்தை ஒப்புக்கொண்டதாக U.S. Attorney's Office for the District of Connecticut தெரிவித்துள்ளது.

title: Ant International’s Antom supports Google Gemini push into Asian markets
summary: Google Gemini and Antom, a leading merchant payment and digitisation services provider under Ant International, today announced a strategic partnership to make AI tools for learning, creativity and productivity more accessible to users in Asia.
content: Ant International’s merchant payment and digitisation services provider, Antom, has announced a strategic partnership with Google Gemini. The collaboration aims to make advanced AI tools focused on learning, creativity, and productivity more accessible to users across Asian markets, expanding the reach of these technologies in the region.
content_ta: Ant International-ன் கீழ் இயங்கும் வணிகர் கட்டண மற்றும் டிஜிட்டல் சேவை வழங்குநரான Antom, Google Gemini உடன் ஒரு மூலோபாயக் கூட்டாண்மையை அறிவித்துள்ளது. கற்றல், படைப்பாற்றல் மற்றும் உற்பத்தித்திறனுக்கான மேம்பட்ட AI கருவிகளை ஆசிய சந்தைகளில் உள்ள பயனர்களுக்கு மேலும் அணுகக்கூடியதாக மாற்றுவதை இந்த ஒத்துக்கம் நோக்கமாகக் கொண்டுள்ளது.
